# @trysac/accessible-chart-config

> Turn chart data into an accessible, library-neutral chart config: WCAG 3:1 contrast-checked colours, dash and marker redundancy, a generated text summary and a data table fallback. TypeScript library for Node.js 20+, published as an ES module with type declarations. MIT.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, installation, usage example and API
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): module, boundaries and build
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): the unit tests in `test/index.test.ts`
- [Project record](docs/PROJECT.md): objective, scope, timeline and effort metrics
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model, secrets, dependencies and code practices
